entries.4d4ab49b405e2cf7: Since its founding in 1909, it has operated as an independent securities company belonging to no affiliated group. It has both a face-to-face sales network of stores at its head office and 28 branches and sales offices, and online trading, and is shifting toward an asset-management-based business that builds up investment trust balances.
entries.4f2c114a4442bfdb: As an independent securities company belonging to no affiliated group, its basic management policy is to build on the spirit of 'jishu dokuritsu' (self-reliance and independence). The medium-term management plan starting in fiscal 2024 aims to move away from a revenue structure dependent on trading commissions and to establish one based on balance-linked income, such as investment trust trust fees. In July 2025, the company began handling the Marusan Fund Wrap Service, its own service based on goal-based asset management. In March 2026, it set a new management philosophy: 'Build trust through financial services that put customers first, and realize aspirations together.'
